# Lernova

> Lernova is an Android learning app with AI-led classes for grades 10 to 12, fixed practice exams with personal AI feedback, and live rooms for instructors.

## What Lernova offers

- AI classes by grade: a weekly schedule for grades 10 to 12, one topic per day, a class every 2 hours, all times in New York time.
- A full AI lesson: video, written explanation read aloud, quiz, results with explanations, personal feedback, questions and summary.
- Similar exams: fixed questions, 10 to 50 per exam, split evenly into easy, medium and hard; score out of 100; a worked explanation for every answer; personal AI analysis.
- Live rooms: instructors create rooms and share invite links; guests can join; public rooms can be browsed by category or topic.
- Languages: uses the device language by default; English, Persian, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Turkish, Russian, Chinese and Hindi.
- AI assistant: Gemini works inside the app. ChatGPT and Claude are coming soon.

## Status

Grade 10 Geometry exams are available first. Voice and video calling in rooms and more exam topics are coming soon.
